params.description: The `Tensor` from which to gather values. Must be at least rank `axis + 1`.

indices.description: The index `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. The values must be in range `[0, params.shape[axis])`.
constraints: indices must be one of int32, int64

validate_indices.description: Deprecated, does nothing. Indices are always validated on CPU, never validated on GPU.

Caution.description: On CPU, if an out of bound index is found, an error is raised. On GPU, if an out of bound index is found, a 0 is stored in the corresponding output value.
constraints: Caution must be one of CPU, GPU

axis.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. The `axis` in `params` to gather `indices` from. Must be greater than or equal to `batch_dims`. Defaults to the first non-batch dimension. Supports negative indexes.
constraints: axis must be one of int32, int64

batch_dims.description: An `integer`. The number of batch dimensions. Must be less than or equal to `rank(indices)`.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `params`.
